prompt: Four friends raced around the park, and Chidi ran (fast) of all.
explanation_ru: Бежали четверо друзей, и оборот of all указывает на превосходную степень наречия fast — the fastest (или fastest).

prompt: We hung three coats in the hall, and my jacket was (wet).
explanation_ru: Сравниваются три куртки, поэтому нужна превосходная степень короткого прилагательного wet с удвоением согласной — the wettest.

prompt: Which one of these three town papers is ___?
explanation_ru: Выбор идёт из трёх газет, поэтому нужна превосходная степень короткого прилагательного new — the newest. Частая ошибка — использовать сравнительную степень (newer) или форму с most.

prompt: The green dragon never helps the other four, so it works (little).
explanation_ru: Всего пять драконов (зелёный и четверо остальных), поэтому нужна превосходная степень наречия little — the least.

prompt: All five guesthouse owners were kind, but Priya was the nicest host we met.
answer: All five guesthouse owners were kind, but Priya was the nicest host we met.
accepted_answers: All five guesthouse owners were kind, but Priya was the nicest host we met.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: при выборе одного человека из пяти правильно использована превосходная степень the nicest.

prompt: Don't pick the yellow bag — it holds (few / clothes) than the blue one.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются две сумки с союзом than, а существительное clothes исчисляемое, поэтому нужна форма fewer clothes.

prompt: Our cycling club checked five routes to the station, so which one has (few / crossings) and feels (safe) in the dark?
explanation_ru: Выбор делается из пяти маршрутов, поэтому в обоих пропусках требуется превосходная степень: the fewest с исчисляемым существительным crossings и the safest.

prompt: This small delivery van handles narrow streets well, yet it climbs steep country hills (badly) than our older van.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два фургона с союзом than, поэтому от наречия badly образуется неправильная сравнительная степень worse.

prompt: The new community hall fits our whole choir easily, and its stage is ___ of all the venues in town.
explanation_ru: Оборот of all the venues указывает на превосходную степень, а односложное слово wide образует её через -est (the widest). Типичная ошибка — ставить most перед коротким прилагательным.

prompt: Listen to all six songs on Henrik's new album — the final guitar track is the most loveliest of them all.
answer: Listen to all six songs on Henrik's new album — the final guitar track is the loveliest of them all.
accepted_answers: Listen to all six songs on Henrik's new album — the final guitar track is the loveliest of them all.
explanation_ru: Нельзя сочетать most и суффикс -est в одном слове (двойная превосходная степень): правильно the loveliest.

prompt: In the luggage shop, both the green suitcase and the blue one cost £35. All the other suitcases on the shelf cost more.
options: The green suitcase is cheaper than the blue one.
The green suitcase is the only cheap suitcase in the shop.
The green suitcase is one of the cheapest suitcases in the shop.
The green suitcase is more cheaper than the rest.
explanation_ru: Зелёный чемодан делит самую низкую цену с синим, поэтому к ситуации подходит именно конструкция one of the cheapest suitcases.

prompt: Only one other kettle in the test matched this steel model for reliability, and none beat it. → This steel kettle is one of …
answer: This steel kettle is one of the most reliable kettles in the test.
accepted_answers: This steel kettle is one of the most reliable kettles in the test.
This steel kettle is one of the most reliable models in the test.
This steel kettle is one of the most reliable in the test.
explanation_ru: Конструкция one of the + превосходная степень + существительное во множественном числе передаёт идею, что модель входит в число лучших, но не является единственной.

prompt: Our café manager changed the shift timetable to cover extra morning deliveries. The new plan doesn't solve everything, because drivers stay late (often) than they would like. My colleague Nadia also finishes (late) than she did under the old plan. Even so, everyone agrees Saturday morning remains (busy) shift of the whole week.
explanation_ru: Союз than в двух предложениях требует сравнительных наречий (more often, later), а выделение одной смены из всей недели (of the whole week) — превосходной степени the busiest.

prompt: In a formal comparison of the two neighbourhood polls, Survey A is ___, yet neither poll ranks among the most accurate studies in the national report.
options: the most accurate of the two
the more accurate of the two
explanation_ru: В официальном сравнении ровно двух объектов с of the two используется the + сравнительная степень (the more accurate of the two), а не превосходная (the most accurate).

prompt: The book's final chapter is too short to cover all the voyages, yet it explains the mistakes (clearly) than the earlier pages and presents its (important) claim.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске союз than требует сравнительного наречия more clearly, а во втором после притяжательного местоимения its артикль the не ставится (its most important claim).

prompt: The city council asked residents for feedback on turning High Street into a tram-only zone. Among all the groups who replied, car commuters reacted (angrily) to the idea. Local shopkeepers, however, backed the plan (warmly) than they had during the winter talks. By Friday evening, the council had received (many / letters) from cyclists than from any other group.
explanation_ru: Среди всех групп выделяется самая резкая реакция (the most angrily), а затем с союзом than сравниваются два периода (more warmly) и объём писем от разных групп (more letters).

prompt: Eleven local builders sent us written quotes to repair the leaking school gym roof. The family firm from our own street didn't promise a miracle, yet they charged (little) of all eleven companies. Their main drawback was timing, because we would have to wait (long) for materials than with the bigger chains. Still, our headteacher chose them because past customers said they worked (well) than their bigger rivals on nearby schools.
explanation_ru: Из одиннадцати компаний выбирается минимальная цена (the least), а затем при сопоставлении с крупными фирмами через than используются сравнительные наречия longer и better.

prompt: We fitted a new water filter under the kitchen sink to fix the strange taste from our tap. Among all the flats in our block, our tap water tastes (clean), so we never buy plastic bottles any more. However, changing the inner ring doesn't go smoothly, and the job takes (much / time) than the shop assistant promised. On Sunday my brother Owen had to push (hard) than before to lock the lid back in place.
explanation_ru: Выражение Among all the flats требует превосходной степени (the cleanest), а союз than в следующих предложениях — сравнительных форм more time (с существительным) и harder (наречие).
